title: Fonctions L / Équation fonctionnelle des fonctions L (cas géométrique) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. X is a smooth variety, purely of dimension n, over F_p. The machine reading 'propre' is almost certainly 'purement': the appearance of both Rf_! and Rf_* and of a term at infinity shows X is NOT assumed proper. The structure map f: X -> Spec F_p is compactifiable/separated. E is a lisse (constructible) l-adic sheaf, 'tordu' self-dual of weight ρ: by hypothesis its dual satisfies Ě ≅ E(ρ).

Aim. Derive the functional equation of the L-function L_E(t) of Rf_!E on a possibly non-proper variety, including the correction factor coming from infinity.

Steps.
(1) Duality (Verdier/Poincaré, SGA4 XVIII): D Rf_!(E) ≅ Rf_*(D E).
(2) For X smooth of pure dimension n and E lisse: D_X E = Ě(n)[2n]. By the self-duality hypothesis this is ≅ E(ρ+n)[2n].
(3) Hence D Rf_!(E) ≅ (Rf_*E)(ρ+n)[2n].
(4) Pass to classes in the Grothendieck group of Frobenius modules. The even shift [2n] does not change the class. Let Rf_∞ denote the cone of Rf_! -> Rf_*, the 'cohomology at infinity'. Then cl Rf_* = cl Rf_! + cl Rf_∞, so cl D(Rf_!E) = cl(Rf_!E)(ρ+n) + cl(Rf_∞E)(ρ+n).
(5) Pass to L-functions with L(K,t) = Π det(1 - F t | H^i K)^{(-1)^{i+1}}.
 - Dualizing gives L(DK,t) = (-t)^{-χ(K)} δ(K) L(K,1/t), where δ is the alternating product of Frobenius determinants (with the appropriate sign convention).
 - A Tate twist (m) replaces t by p^{-m} t.
 - Multiplicativity along the exact triangle gives L_* = L_! · L_∞.
This yields (-t)^{-χ(E)} δ(E) L_E(1/t) = L_E(p^{-(ρ+n)} t) · L^∞_E(p^{-(ρ+n)} t).

This is the standard 'functional equation up to a factor at infinity' for open varieties, i.e. the cohomological functional equation à la SGA5. The page ends with 'ou encore', announcing a reformulation on the following page, which is missing here.
errors: No real mathematical error. With L defined as the alternating product of det(1-Ft) over the H^i_c, dualization gives L(DK,t) = (-t)^{-χ}·(alternating product of det F)^{±1}·L(K,1/t), so the formula is right up to the convention for δ.
Minor: the base is written F_p; for F_q one must replace p by q in p^{-(ρ+n)}.
χ(E) should be read as χ_c(X,E) = χ(Rf_!E).
The interpretation of 'tordu purement de poids ρ' as the self-duality Ě ≅ E(ρ) is inferred. It is the hypothesis actually used in the line DE = Ě(n)[2n] ≃ E(ρ+n)[2n].

Functional equation of L-functions via duality, with a correction factor L^∞ coming from the cone of Rf_! -> Rf_*

deep.surprise_reason: A clean, correct working-out of the standard duality-derived functional equation for an open smooth variety with a self-dual (up to twist) lisse sheaf. This material is in Grothendieck's Bourbaki talk and SGA5. Nothing appears to be absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'X lisse purement de dim n', not 'propre'. Non-properness is required by the later use of Rf_!, Rf_* and Rf_∞.
Line 2: probably 'E est tordu purement de poids ρ' (i.e. Ě ≅ E(ρ)), possibly with 'ét.'/'est' rather than 'et'.
Line 3: 'comp. séparable' is uncertain; possibly 'compactifiable' / 'séparé'. The crossed-out word is 'Spec'.
Line 'Or pour lisse[?] on E' should read 'Or par hypothèse sur E'.
In 'D Rf_!(E) ≃ (Rf_*(E))(ρ+n)[2n]' the pushforward on the right is Rf_* (correctly transcribed).
First class line: the right side is '(cl Rf_*(E)) (ρ+n)' with a struck-out factor (not '.[...]'). The pushforward there is Rf_*, not Rf_!.
The last formula should be read with the struck-out characters removed: (-t)^{-χ(E)} δ(E) L_E(1/t) = L_E(p^{-(ρ+n)} t) L^∞_E(p^{-(ρ+n)} t). The last factor is cut off at the page edge.
